name: Storms
overview: Scripture portrays storms not only as physical realities but also as spiritual trials from which God provides refuge and deliverance. Believers are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that the Lord goes with them and will never forsake them. God’s sovereignty is displayed in His power to still the storm and offer a place of shelter and protection, inviting His people to be still and recognize His supreme authority amid life’s tempests.
